title: Inoki vs. Hogan: the first IWGP struggle
summary: Hulk Hogan’s victory in the inaugural IWGP League shocks New Japan. Inoki returns to reclaim the tournament crown, while the two also maintain a successful tag-team relationship.

chapters.title: Hogan wins the inaugural IWGP final
chapters.result: Hogan defeats Inoki after the Axe Bomber sends him from the apron.
chapters.context: The result makes Hogan the first IWGP League winner. This annual tournament crown predates the regularly defended IWGP Heavyweight Championship introduced in 1987.

chapters.title: Inoki reclaims the IWGP crown
chapters.result: Inoki defeats Hogan by count-out after Choshu’s interference.
chapters.context: The disputed finish gives Inoki the tournament payoff but leaves the rivalry far from a simple clean victory.
